turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
The rule: put always, usually, sometimes or never before the action word, but after am, is or are.
Right: "Owls usually hunt at night."
Wrong: "Owls hunt usually at night." Usually is in the wrong place, after hunt.
I think aloud: "The zoo is always busy."
First, I look for an action word. There is none; there is is.
Next, always goes after is.
Your turn. Put the words in order:
"usually / my cousin / walks / to school"
